content: Jesu Taitin Bairi
Nati ufunamaim Jesu Galilee wanawanan run titit remor in, men kok au Judea tan anayabin Jew hai ukwarih hima hikakaif hitarab tamorob isan.
Baise Jew sabuw Yagama Sis ana hiyuw aa ana veya i nabiyubin,
Imih Jesu taitin hi’o, “O boro efan iti inihamiy naatu inan Judea inatit, saise a bai’ufununayah bowabow gewasih abistan kusisinaf hina’itin.
Anayabin orot yait sabuw etei su’ubin isan boro men wa’iwa’iramaim nabowamih. Baise bebeyanamaim nabow hina’itin. Imih a bowabow bebeyanamaim inabow tafaram tutufin etei ini’obaiyih hina’itin.”
I taiyuwin taitin men hitumitum, imih iti tur hi’o.
Naatu Jesu iuwih eo, “Ayu au veya i men na tit, baise kwa a veya i mar etei bobotawiyen inu’in.
Sabuw kwa boro men hinifutuwi, baise ayu boro hinifutuwu, anayabin ayu mar etei sabuw hai kakafih ao’orerereb.
Hiyuw isan kwa akis kwanan ayu men bairit tanan, anayabin ayu au veya anababatun i men na tit.”
Iti na’atube eo, i Galilee wanawananamaim ma.
Taitin hiyuw isan hiyen hinan, i auman ufuh yen in, men bebeyanamaim in baise i wa’iwa’iramaim in.
Nati hiyuw wanawanan Jew hai ukwarih Jesu isan hinuwet sabuw hibabatiyih, “Iti orot menamaim ema’am?”
Sabuw wanawanahimaim baitarsibesib busuruf ra’at. Sabuw afa hi’o, “I orot gewasin,” afa hi’o, “Aiyabin i sabuw ebifufuwih?”
Baise men yait ta boro fanan aumetawat isan hitao, anayabin Jew ukwarih isah hibir.
Hiyuw hi’aa na biyanfoun, Jesu na Tafaror Bar run naatu bai’obaiyen busuruf.
Jew hai ukwarih hifofofor men kafai ta naatu hi’o, “Iti orot menamaim kirum iti so’ob bai?”
Imaibo Jesu iyafutih eo, “Bai’obaiyen ayu abi’obaiyi i men ayu nowau, baise God ayu biyafaru i nowan.
O Yait ta God anakok kusisinaf boro inaso’ob ayu au bai’obaiyen i Godane enan, ai ayu taiyuwu au fairamaim ao’o.
Yait taiyuwin ana fairamaim eo’o, i taiyuwin ana gewasin bain isan enunuwih, baise orot yait God ayu iyafaru anan ana gewasin enunuwih nati orot i turobe, i wanawananamaim men baifuwen ema’am.
Moses ofafar kwa it ai en? Aisim ofafafar men kwabi’ufunun naatu ayu rabu morobomih kwabiwa’an?”
Sabuw hiya’afut hi’o, “O wanawan i demon tema’am. Yait o asabunimih ebiwa’an?”
Jesu iya’afutih eo, “Ayu ina’inan ta’imon asinaf kwa’itin naatu kwaifofor men kafaita.
Moses uwi natunat oro’orot Baiyariri hai veya’amaim hai ar, mo’oh kwa’afuw, nati i men Mosesine na, nati i kwa a’agir wabih gagamihine na. Imih kwa kek oro’orot hai ar mo’oh kwa’a’afuw.
Kwa Baiyarir ana veya’amaim kek orot ana ar mo’on kwana’a’afuw nati Moses ana ofafar i men kwa’a’astu’ub, aisimamih ayu Baiyarir Ana Veya orot biyan tutufin abiyawas isan kwa ya esoso’ar?
Men ufun ana’itininamaim sabuw kwanibabatiyih, baise a baibabatiyen i turobe’emaim kwanibatiyih.”
Jesu I Roubininenayan?
Nati isan Jerusalem sabuw afa hibusuruf hibatebat hi’o, “Orotoban iti i boun rabin morobomih ana ef tenunuwet?
Kwa’itin iban iti bebeyanamaim eo’o, naatu i men tur ta isan te’eo’omih. Kwa kwanotanot sabuw ukwarihiban hiso’ob gewas iti orot i turobe Rourubinen?
Baise iti orot menane nan i aki aso’ob; Rourubinen nanan anamaramaim boro men yait ta naso’ob i menane na.”

Imaibo Jesu Tafaror bar wanawanan ma bi’obaibiyih fanan aumetawat na’in eo, “Turobe ayu kwa kwaso’ob, naatu menane anan kwa kwaso’ob? Ayu iti anan i men taiyuwu au kok ana, baise turobe ana God ayu iyunu ana. Nati orot kwa men kwaso’ob
ayu asu’ub, anayabin ayu ine ana naatu i iyunu ana.”
Nati’imaim sabuw bain fatuminamih hiwa’an, baise men yait ta biyan butubun, anayabin ana veya i men natit.
Baise rou’ay gagamin wanawanan sabuw moumurin maiyow hitumitum naatu hi’o, “Rourubinen nanan ina’inan fairih moumurihika nasinaf iti orot boro nanatabir.”
Ma’utenayah Hiyunih Hin Jesu Hitabaimih
Rou’ay wanawanan Jesu sawar sisinaf isan hibitarsibesib Pharisee hinowar. Basit firis gagagamih naatu Pharisee Tafaror Bar ma’utayah hiyafarih hin Jesu bain fatuminamih.
Imih Jesu eo, “Ayu boro men manin bairit tanama, naatu anamatabir maiye anan yait iyunu anan biyan anatit.
Kwa boro ayu kwananuwuhu, baise boro men kwanatita’uru, naatu ayu menamaim anama’am, kwa boro men kwanan.”
Jew sabuw taiyuwih hima hi’o, “Iti orot boro menamaim nan nama naatu it men karam tanatita’ur? Ai i boro nan Greek wanawanah ata sabuw hitagey nanabin tema’am imaim nama ni’obaibiyih?
Kwa boro ayu isou kwananuwet baise boro men kwanatita’uru naatu ayu menamaim anama’am kwa boro men kwanan? Iti tur eo’o anayabin i abisa?”
Yawas Ana Harew
Hiyuw gagamin hi’aa sasawar ana yomanin, Jesu misir naatu fanan aumetawat na’in eo, “Yait ta sikan namamamah, kwanihamiy nan ayu biyau harew natom!
Yait ayu inabitutumu na’at kuna biyau harew kutom. Buk Atamaninamaim eo na’atube ‘Harew yawasin boro o wanawananamaim nanunuw.’”
Iti tur i sabuw iyab Jesu hinibitumitum Anun Kakafiyin hinabaib i isah eo. Iti boun ana veya Anun Kakafiyin i men yait itin bai, anayabin Jesu i men Tamah ana aiwob itinimih.
Kousib Matar
Rou’ay wanawanan hima tur hinonowar sabuw afa hi’o, “Anababatun iti orot i God ana dinab orot.”
Afa hi’o, “Iti orot i Rourubinen.” Naatu sabuw afa ibanak hi’o, “Rourubinen ana orot i boro men Galilee’ine nan?
Buk Atamaninamaim eo Rourubinen i boro aiwob orot David ana rara’ane naatu boro Bethlehem David ana bar meraramaim.”
Imih nati kou’ay wanawanan kouseb matar anayabin Jesu isan.
Sabuw afa hikok hitab hitafatum, baise men yait ta biyan butubun.
Jew Hai Ukwarih Men Hitumatum
Imaibo Tafaror bar ma’utenayah himatabir hin firis ukwarih naatu Pharisee biyah hitit naatu firis ukwarih himisir ma’utenayah hibatiyih, “Aisimamih men kwa bai kwana kwatit?”
Ma’utenayah hiya’afutih hi’o, “Iti orot tur eo’o, i men orot afa te’eo na’atube eomih!”
Pharisee hibatiyih, “Kwa kwa’o anananiyan kwa auman ifuwi ebobonawiyi kakaf i?”
“Kwata’itin ukwarih afa o Pharisee orot afa tur hinonowaraban Jesu hitumitum?
Aiyabin! Iti rou’ay Moses ana ofafar i men ta hiso’ob, imih i God ana orarafen baban tema’am!”
I taiyuwih hai orot ta wabin Nicodemus i wan in Jesu biyan tit,
Imih i ana kou’ay ibatiyih, “It ata ofafar eo orot anasinaf kakaf i wan tananuwet imaibo tanab tanan ata ofafaramaim tanibabatiy.”
Hiya’afut hi’o, “Nicodemus o auman i Galilee orot? Baise Buk Atamaninamaim inanunuwet boro men inatita’ur, dinab orot i men Galilee’ine na.”
(Naatu rou’ay hima’am hitarboubun himisir hai bar hai bar hin.)
